mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_usage_plan (id,tenant_id,plan_version,token_quota,created_at,updated_at,created_by,updated_by) VALUES (#{id},#{event.tenantId},#{event.version},#{event.tokenQuota},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,NULL,NULL) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id) WHERE NOT deleted DO UPDATE SET plan_version=EXCLUDED.plan_version, token_quota=EXCLUDED.token_quota, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=NULL WHERE ai_usage_plan.plan_version < EXCLUDED.plan_version
mapper.select: SELECT plan_version, token_quota FROM ai_usage_plan WHERE NOT deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_usage_month(id,tenant_id,billing_month,created_at,updated_at,created_by,updated_by) VALUES (#{id},CAST(current_setting('app.tenant_id') AS uuid),#{month},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,NULL,NULL) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,billing_month) WHERE NOT deleted DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM ai_usage_month WHERE billing_month=#{month} AND NOT deleted FOR UPDATE

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='FINISHED' THEN input_tokens ELSE 0 END),0) AS input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='FINISHED' THEN output_tokens ELSE 0 END),0) AS output_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='FINISHED' THEN cached_input_tokens ELSE 0 END),0) AS cached_input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(estimated_tokens),0) AS estimated_tokens, COUNT(CASE WHEN status='FINISHED' THEN 1 END) AS turn_count, COALESCE(SUM(tool_calls),0) AS tool_calls, COUNT(CASE WHEN unknown_usage THEN 1 END) AS unknown_usage_turns, COUNT(CASE WHEN status='RUNNING' THEN 1 END) AS active_turns FROM ai_usage_ledger WHERE billing_month=#{month} AND NOT deleted

SELECT usage_date,snapshot_version AS version,input_tokens,output_tokens,cached_input_tokens,turn_count,tool_calls,unknown_usage_turns,estimated_tokens,reported_at FROM ai_usage_daily WHERE usage_date >=#{from} AND usage_date <#{to} AND NOT deleted ORDER BY usage_date
SELECT * FROM ai_usage_ledger WHERE billing_month=#{month} AND status='RUNNING' AND created_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '3' MINUTE AND NOT deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_usage_daily(id,tenant_id,usage_date,snapshot_version,input_tokens,output_tokens,cached_input_tokens,estimated_tokens,turn_count,tool_calls,unknown_usage_turns,reported_at,created_at,updated_at,created_by,updated_by) SELECT #{id},CAST(current_setting('app.tenant_id') AS uuid),#{date},1, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens),0),COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens),0),COALESCE(SUM(cached_input_tokens),0),COALESCE(SUM(estimated_tokens),0), COUNT(*),COALESCE(SUM(tool_calls),0),COUNT(CASE WHEN unknown_usage THEN 1 END),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,NULL,NULL FROM ai_usage_ledger WHERE usage_date=#{date} AND status='FINISHED' AND NOT deleted ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,usage_date) WHERE NOT deleted DO UPDATE SET snapshot_version=ai_usage_daily.snapshot_version+1, input_tokens=EXCLUDED.input_tokens,output_tokens=EXCLUDED.output_tokens,cached_input_tokens=EXCLUDED.cached_input_tokens, estimated_tokens=EXCLUDED.estimated_tokens,turn_count=EXCLUDED.turn_count,tool_calls=EXCLUDED.tool_calls, unknown_usage_turns=EXCLUDED.unknown_usage_turns,reported_at=EXCLUDED.reported_at,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=NULL
mapper.select: SELECT usage_date,snapshot_version AS version,input_tokens,output_tokens,cached_input_tokens,turn_count,tool_calls,unknown_usage_turns,estimated_tokens,reported_at FROM ai_usage_daily WHERE usage_date=#{date} AND NOT deleted
